# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stand for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $98).** WIRED named it best overall in its [3-in-1 charger roundup](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/). It charges the iPhone at 15W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. A 36W power supply is included, and the warranty is 2 years. WIRED listed it at $109, marked down to $98, with Amazon at $90 and Best Buy at $80. Check current prices, since those may have changed.

## Other good options

- **Fastest: [Nomad Stand One Max](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) ($169).** It delivers Qi2 25W and has a heavy base and a nice 6.6 ft cable. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one (WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter, $25).
- **Cheapest: [ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) (about $40 on Amazon).** It's 15W, comes with a charger and cable, and the Watch charger detaches. It has only a 1-year warranty.
- **Lies flat: [Nimble Podium 3-in-1](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) ($130).** It's Qi2 25W, and the pads can pop up for StandBy. Watch charging is slow, so it's best for overnight.
- **Foldable for travel:**
  - [Anker MagGo 3-in-1](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) (about $80) is 15W and compact.
  - [Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) ($129.99) is the tallest and most adjustable foldable that Macworld has tested, and it works well as a desk stand.
  - [ESR CryoBoost 25W](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) has a cooling fan with an off button. It's $99.99 at ESR, and that page lists code PARTNER18 for about $82 (expires 2026-12-31). That's an affiliate link, and the store's checkout has the final word on the price.

## Is 25W worth paying for?

Only if you have a recent phone. ESR's page says full 25W applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other recent models get about 20W, and older ones get 15W. WIRED also says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the Belkin is the better value for most people.

Before buying, check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging, since not all do.

I couldn't open the retailer pages directly, so the links above go to the review pages and the one ESR store page, not to individual product listings.
